note: Headline kernel-checked results. The complete theorem inventory (every `theorem`-kind declaration with file and axiom cone) is in verified-declarations.json.

headline.claim: Finite-dimensional curvature-tensor algebra probe: skew-symmetry, Bianchi, Ricci trace and additivity are kernel-checked.
headline.note: Probe only: mathlib has no Riemann curvature tensor (blocker U1).

headline.claim: Levi-Civita uniqueness and torsion antisymmetry toy probes are kernel-checked.
Discrete heat-slab maximum-principle probe and affine heat-slab interface are kernel-checked; the continuous interface is statement-only.
headline.note: HeatSlabMaximumPrincipleInterface is an unproved Prop (blocker U6/I2).

headline.claim: Perelman F/W/mu interfaces are defined and the toy monotonicity lemmas are kernel-checked.
headline.note: The F/W/mu monotonicity structures are hypotheses, not proved theorems (blockers U12).

headline.claim: Abstract connection curvature identities: skew, Bianchi, cyclic decomposition, Ricci additivity, scalar additivity/scaling and the basis trace formula.
headline.note: Algebraic identities over abstract data; not differential-geometric curvature of a manifold.

headline.claim: Levi-Civita uniqueness and metric-compatibility equivalence are kernel-checked; existence and covariant-derivative curvature are explicit unproved Props.
headline.note: LeviCivitaExistenceStatement and CovariantDerivativeCurvatureStatement are BLOCKED Props (blocker I1).

headline.claim: Discrete maximum principle on a finite heat grid: the evolution never exceeds the initial supremum and the discrete energy is non-increasing.
headline.note: Finite-grid content only; ContinuousHeatMaximumPrincipleInterface is statement-only (blocker I2).

headline.claim: The non-negative orthant is invariant under the finite-dimensional Hamilton reaction ODE (continuous and explicit-Euler discrete).
The scalar curvature functional of the finite-dimensional reaction ODE is monotone (continuous and discrete).
headline.note: scalarCurvature_monotone_of_bridge is conditional on the uninhabited TensorRicciFlowODEBridge (blocker I3).

headline.claim: Entropy interface: F/W data, monotonicity and decay certificates, their composition and the discrete heat-energy certificate are kernel-checked; all analytic inputs are explicit hypotheses.
headline.note: No Perelman entropy monotonicity: FDerivativeStatement, WeightedIBPStatement, BochnerStatement, ConjugateMeasureEvolutionStatement and EntropyFunctionalRegularityStatement are unproved Props (blocker I4).

headline.claim: Compact 3-manifold class yields the expected topological consequences (sigma-compact, paracompact, locally compact, second countable, finite chart cover).
kappa-noncollapsing certificate algebra and its equivalence with the normalized-ball-volume lower bound are kernel-checked.
headline.note: The non-collapsing theorem itself (K1-K7) is statement-only (blocker I5).

headline.claim: Surgery ledger interface: datum/predicates/certificate constructors and chain composition preserve the ledger invariants.
headline.note: NeckAnalysis, ExtinctionTheorem and MissingInputs are statement-only (blocker I6); orientability is a parameter (U11).

headline.claim: Toy extinction skeleton: the toy complexity relation strictly decreases and admits no infinite chain.
headline.note: Toy relation only; it models the decreasing part of extinction, not a geometric neck surgery.

headline.claim: Finite Gibbs-weighted functional perelmanF is antitone along the D2 evolution relation (continuous and discrete), with an explicit dissipation identity.
headline.note: NOT Perelman F-monotonicity: finite sum, c is abstract data, FDissipation = 0, sign convention opposite to Perelman's F (blockers A2/I7).

headline.claim: D3 antitone certificates are instantiated for the evolution cluster (continuous and discrete).
headline.note: Transfer theorems are conditional on uninhabited interfaces (blocker I8).

headline.claim: Adversarial audit found no false statement; three promoted theorems have overstrong hypotheses and sharp-hypothesis replacements are kernel-checked.
headline.note: Blocker A1: upstream restatement recommended; corrected declarations live in D4Audit.

headline.claim: Counterexamples delimit the hypotheses of the D4 cluster and non-vacuity checks confirm the main theorem is not vacuous.
headline.note: Audit scope covers the D4 evolution cluster only (blocker A3).
